mapper.select: SELECT supplierId, supplierName, contactPerson, phone, address, status FROM supplier ORDER BY supplierId DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supplier(supplierName, contactPerson, phone, address, status) VALUES(#{supplierName}, #{contactPerson}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE supplier SET supplierName = #{request.supplierName}, contactPerson = #{request.contactPerson}, phone = #{request.phone}, address = #{request.address}, status = #{request.status} WHERE supplierId = #{supplierId}
